assertion_results.text: Epics are generated between Feature and Tasks — at least 2 Epics are created (one per repository) when by-repository grouping is used
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md documents 2 Epics with by-repository grouping (line 15: 'Grouping strategy: by-repository'). Epic 1: 'TC-9006: trustify-backend' (line 19), Epic 2: 'TC-9006: trustify-ui' (line 35). Both are positioned between the Feature (TC-9006) and the 6 Tasks.

assertion_results.text: Each Epic summary follows the format '<feature-key>: <repository-name>' (e.g., 'TC-9006: trustify-backend', 'TC-9006: trustify-ui')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md line 22: 'Summary: TC-9006: trustify-backend'; line 37: 'Summary: TC-9006: trustify-ui'. Both follow the '<feature-key>: <repository-name>' format exactly.

assertion_results.text: Each task specifies its parent Epic key in the output — tasks targeting trustify-backend are assigned to the backend Epic, tasks targeting trustify-ui are assigned to the frontend Epic
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md Task-to-Epic Assignments table (lines 92-99): Task 1 (trustify-backend) → TC-9006: trustify-backend; Task 2 (trustify-backend) → TC-9006: trustify-backend; Task 3 (trustify-ui) → TC-9006: trustify-ui; Task 4 (trustify-ui) → TC-9006: trustify-ui; Task 5 (trustify-ui) → TC-9006: trustify-ui; Task 6 (trustify-backend) → TC-9006: trustify-backend. All backend tasks assigned to backend Epic, all frontend tasks assigned to frontend Epic.

assertion_results.text: The plan documents Incorporates links from the Feature to each Epic (not from Feature to individual Tasks) — evidenced by link decisions in the impact map or task output files
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md lines 57-62: 'TC-9006 Incorporates Epic 1 (TC-9006: trustify-backend)' and 'TC-9006 Incorporates Epic 2 (TC-9006: trustify-ui)'. Explicitly states 'Tasks inherit hierarchy through their Epic parent field. No Feature-to-Task Incorporates links are created.' summary-comment.md lines 29-34 confirms: 'No direct Feature-to-Task Incorporates links were created.'

assertion_results.text: Task dependency ordering is preserved within and across Epics — backend tasks have lower task numbers than dependent frontend tasks
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md dependency graph (lines 103-111): Task 1 (backend) → Task 2 (backend) → Task 3 (frontend) → Task 4 (frontend) → Task 5 (frontend) → Task 6 (docs). Backend tasks (1, 2) have lower numbers than dependent frontend tasks (3, 4, 5). Task 3 depends on Tasks 1 and 2; Task 4 depends on Task 3; Task 5 depends on Tasks 3 and 4.

assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation, non-testing task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks (tasks whose filename or description indicates doc-only scope) and testing tasks (tasks whose filename or description indicates cross-cutting testing scope) are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Tasks 1-5 (non-doc) all contain: Repository, Target Branch, Description, Files to Create, Files to Modify, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Task 6 (documentation, filename 'task-6-documentation.md') contains Repository ('trustify-backend'), Target Branch ('main'), Description, Acceptance Criteria (6 criteria), Test Requirements (3 requirements) — exempt sections (Files to Modify/Create, Implementation Notes) are correctly omitted.

assertion_results.text: The plan documents Epic creation with the level-1 issue type name ('Epic') and parent set to the feature issue key — evidenced by Epic creation parameters in the impact map or output files
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md line 17: 'Level-1 issue type: Epic (hierarchyLevel: 1)'. Epic 1 creation parameters (lines 27-32): issueTypeName: Epic, parent: TC-9006. Epic 2 creation parameters (lines 42-47): issueTypeName: Epic, parent: TC-9006. Both Epics explicitly set parent to the Feature key TC-9006.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Repository section with a single repository name (not multiple repos per task)
assertion_results.evidence: Task 1: 'trustify-backend'; Task 2: 'trustify-backend'; Task 3: 'trustify-ui'; Task 4: 'trustify-ui'; Task 5: 'trustify-ui'; Task 6: 'trustify-backend'. Each task has exactly one repository name under its Repository section.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements sections as required by the handoff contract in task-description-template.md
assertion_results.evidence: All 6 task files contain: '## Target Branch' (all set to 'main'), '## Description' (substantive descriptions), '## Acceptance Criteria' (with checkbox items), '## Test Requirements' (with checkbox items). Verified in task-1 through task-6 output files.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: All conventions in Implementation Notes across tasks 1-5 use the prescribed rationale format. Examples: Task 1: 'Applies: task creates modules/fundamental/src/remediation/mod.rs matching the convention's module directory scope'; Task 3: 'Applies: task modifies src/api/rest.ts matching the convention's .ts API layer scope'; Task 5: 'Applies: task creates src/pages/RemediationDashboardPage/components/VulnerabilityTable.tsx matching the convention's .tsx component scope'. No 'Not applicable' annotations found. No free-form prose rationales. Each rationale names a specific file and scope signal.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md line 66: 'Priority: Major (inherited from Feature TC-9006, propagated to all Epics and Tasks)'. Epic creation parameters include priority: {name: Major} for both Epics (lines 31, 46). summary-comment.md line 47: 'Priority: Major — inherited from Feature TC-9006 and propagated to all Epics and Tasks via additional_fields.priority'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md line 67: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (inherited from Feature TC-9006, propagated to all Epics and Tasks; fixVersion scope not configured in Jira Field Defaults, defaults to "both")'. Epic creation parameters include fixVersions: [{name: RHTPA 1.5.0}] for both Epics (lines 32, 47). summary-comment.md line 48: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 — inherited from Feature TC-9006 and propagated to all Epics and Tasks via additional_fields.fixVersions (no fixVersion scope configured in Jira Field Defaults; defaulted to "both")'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in outputs directory and contains 'Inherited Fields' section (lines 46-48): 'Priority: Major — inherited from Feature TC-9006 and propagated to all Epics and Tasks' and 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 — inherited from Feature TC-9006 and propagated to all Epics and Tasks'. impact-map.md also contains 'Inherited Fields' section (lines 65-67) with the same information.
